metadata.rendererClock: Inner performance.now clock around synchronous band.replace(records). Sparse and jump are single calls. Scroll totals sum 31 calls across 32 stock-controller scroll steps. Excludes correctness checks, dispatch, and layout and paint after the call.
metadata.presentationClock: Stock scale fixture Chromium Element Timing of visible status marker relative to trusted click handler entry. Final cell also hit-tested outside clock.
metadata.order: Fresh Chromium per arm/round. Per round cyclic permutation of arms. Jump first via trusted sparse update and jump clicks; separate new browser context/page/model for overlapping scroll.

react.replay: node /path/to/build.cjs (place scale-react-slots.jsx and pool.mjs beside build.cjs)

metadata.method: Untimed synchronous replace on a connected band. MutationObserver counts modifications within the observed band, not detached node construction. Direct add/removal includes reordering an existing child; separate counts identify moves. Start, sparse update and disposal are outside the observer. Each arm gets a fresh page.

reproduction.instructions: Use ceiling.cjs and recycled-cells.mjs from the reproduction sources in renderer-grid-speed-references.json. Build the stock scale modules with the frozen project toolchain. In a temporary directory, save the source files below under their names along with ceiling.cjs and recycled-cells.mjs. From the checkout run node /tmp/path/build.cjs and node /tmp/path/build-saba.cjs (provide ODIN and WEBTOOLS_SHARED for the pinned collection). Substitute the temporary directory for REPLAY_DIRECTORY in the manifest. Run node /tmp/path/ceiling.cjs /tmp/path/arms.json 10 /tmp/path/timings.json, then node /tmp/path/audit-mutations.cjs /tmp/path/arms.json /tmp/path/mutations.json. Set PLAYWRIGHT_PATH to your installed Playwright package as needed.
